text.en: With Change requests & worktrees enabled, the conversation composer offers Git changes, selected-file commits, pushes and local branch switching, with editable commit messages generated by the session’s selected model.
text.zh-CN: 启用“变更请求与工作树”后，对话输入框下方支持查看 Git 改动、提交所选文件、推送和切换本地分支，并可调用会话当前模型生成可编辑的提交信息。
